reviews.text:
I've repurchased this cream multiple times, which probably says everything you need to know about how much I like it. It's become one of those products I always try to keep on hand, especially when my skin is going through a rough patch.

My skin tends to get very dry, and whenever my skin barrier feels compromised or irritated, this cream is one of the first products I reach for. It feels incredibly soothing and helps reduce that tight, uncomfortable feeling while giving my skin the moisture it desperately needs.

Despite being nourishing, it doesn't feel overly heavy or greasy. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling calm, soft, and hydrated for hours. I've found it especially helpful during periods when I've overdone it with actives or when my skin is feeling particularly sensitive.

Overall, this is a fantastic moisturizer for dry, stressed, or barrier-damaged skin. The fact that I've gone through multiple bottles and continue to repurchase it speaks for itself.
reviews.zh:
我已經重複買咗呢款面霜好多次，可能已經好清楚話晒我有幾鍾意佢。佢已經成為我一向都會留返喺身邊嘅產品之一，特別係皮膚狀態差嗰陣。

我嘅皮膚好容易乾，每當皮膚屏障受損或者刺激嗰時，呢款面霜係我第一時間會拎嚟用嘅產品之一。塗落去好舒緩，減輕緊繃、唔舒服嘅感覺，同時補充皮膚極需要嘅水分。

雖然佢營養豐富，但係唔會太厚重或者油膩。佢吸收得好，令皮膚維持平靜、柔軟、水潤好耐。我發現係用咗太多活性成分，或者皮膚特別敏感嗰陣，佢特別有幫助。

總括嚟講，呢款係乾燥、受壓或者屏障受損皮膚嘅一款好好嘅保濕霜。我已經用咗多樽，仲繼續重複購買，已經足以證明一切。

reviews.text:
This cream is much richer and thicker than I expected, but in the best way. It feels very comforting on the skin and is amazing when my barrier needs extra support. Despite the thicker texture, it doesn’t clog my pores or cause breakouts.
It’s extremely calming and helps reduce redness and irritation, especially when my skin feels stressed or sensitized. I love using it at night or during colder months when my skin needs more moisture and protection.
My skin feels smoother, stronger, and less reactive since using this consistently. If you like a nourishing, calming cream that actually supports your barrier, this one delivers.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.zh:
呢款面霜比我預期中厚身好多，但係係好嘅方面。塗喺皮膚上好舒服，當我個屏障需要多啲支援嗰陣，效果好好。雖然質地比較厚，但係唔會堵塞毛孔，亦都唔會爆痘。
佢非常舒緩，特別係皮膚感到有壓力或者變得敏感嗰陣，可以幫助減少紅位同刺激。我鍾意喺晚上用，或者冬天皮膚需要更多水分同保護嗰陣用。
持續使用之後，我嘅皮膚感覺更加平滑、更加堅韌，對刺激嘅反應亦都減少咗。如果你想要一款有營養、舒緩，而且真係能夠支持皮膚屏障嘅面霜，呢款做到。
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.text: This cream is truly calming. I have sensitive skin prone to redness, and it really helps reduce irritation — especially after cleansing or during colder days. The texture is light and non-greasy, absorbs quickly, yet leaves my skin soft and well-moisturized. It doesn’t clog pores or pill. Works well for both morning and night routines. A great choice if you're looking for a gentle but effective soothing cream.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜真係好舒緩。我嘅皮膚敏感、易泛紅，佢真係有助減少刺激，特別係潔面之後或者天氣寒冷嘅日子。質地輕盈、唔油膩，吸收快，但係令皮膚柔軟、保濕充足。唔會堵塞毛孔，亦都唔會起搓。朝早同晚上嘅護膚程序都好啱用。如果你想搵一款溫和但有效嘅舒緩面霜，呢款係好好嘅選擇。

reviews.text: The first time I open it, I am pretty sure I would love the product. For me it is thick but when I put it on my face its actually very light, easily absorbed my skin. Doesn’t irritate, light fragrance. And it is very hydrating and calming moisturizer. The cream has a deep hydration that you would feel the moisture on your skin and that is what I love the most about on this cream. For me this is the best moisturizer I have ever used! I will definitely but again and again on this product! Again!
reviews.zh: 第一次打開嗰陣，我好肯定自己會好鍾意呢款產品。我覺得佢質地厚，但係塗到面上其實好輕盈，皮膚好容易吸收。唔會刺激，香味淡。係一款好滋潤、好舒緩嘅保濕霜。呢款面霜有深層滋潤，你會感覺到皮膚上面嘅水分，呢點係我最鍾意嘅地方。對我嚟講，呢款係我用過最好嘅保濕霜！我一定會一次又一次咁買呢款產品！再買！

reviews.text: I have sensitive, combination skin and decided to try this cream for its calming properties. The texture is rich yet absorbs well without leaving a greasy residue. It effectively soothes redness and irritation, providing lasting hydration. I’ve noticed my skin feels more balanced and less reactive since incorporating it into my routine. While it’s a bit heavy for daytime use, it’s perfect as a nighttime moisturizer. Overall, a great addition for sensitive or dry skin, especially during colder months.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚係敏感、混合性，因為佢嘅舒緩功效，所以試用呢款面霜。質地豐厚，但係吸收得好，唔會留低油膩嘅殘留。佢可以有效舒緩紅位同刺激，提供持久嘅水分。加入我嘅護膚程序之後，我發現皮膚感覺更平衡，對刺激嘅反應亦都減少咗。雖然日間用就有啲厚，但係夜間用作保濕霜就啱啱好。總括嚟講，係敏感或者乾燥皮膚嘅一個好選擇，尤其係天氣寒冷嗰陣。

reviews.text: The Anua Heartleaf 70 Calming Cream is a game-changer for irritated or sensitive skin. It has a lightweight yet deeply soothing texture that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. I noticed reduced redness and more balanced skin after just a few uses. It’s perfect for calming breakouts or post-exfoliation. Plus, it layers well under makeup and other skincare. Definitely a staple in my routine now!
reviews.zh: Anua Heartleaf 70 Calming Cream 對於受刺激或者敏感嘅皮膚嚟講，係一大突破。質地輕盈但舒緩力強，吸收快，唔會有油膩感。我只係用咗幾次就留意到紅位減少，皮膚亦更加平衡。用嚟舒緩爆痘或者去角質之後嘅皮膚都好啱。加上佢喺化妝同其他護膚品底下疊用都好啱。而家絕對係我護膚程序入面必備嘅產品！

reviews.text: I recently started using this moisturizer and I LOVE it. My skin is dry and irritated, and this is now my favourite daytime moisturizer. I like applying several toners and serums on my face and this cream still layers perfectly on top without pilling or looking too shiny. I like a more substantial texture, and this hits the mark perfectly without being too heavy for everyday wear. I feel like I’ve been searching for this type of moisturizer for so long and I’m SO glad I finally discovered this one!
reviews.zh: 我最近開始用呢款保濕霜，我真係好鍾意！我皮膚乾燥又易受刺激，呢款而家係我最鍾意嘅日間保濕霜。我一般會喺面上塗幾款化妝水同精華，而呢款面霜仍然可以完美疊喺上面，唔會起搓，亦唔會睇落太油光。我鍾意質地比較厚實嘅面霜，呢款正好啱啱好，又唔會太厚重，啱晒日常使用。我感覺自己已經搵咗好耐呢類保濕霜，我好開心終於發現咗呢款！

reviews.text:
this cream is a powerhouse when it comes to soothing the skin. it effectively alleviates redness, irritation, and inflammation, making it a go-to product for calming my skin.

the cream has a lightweight, non-greasy texture that feels comfortable on the skin. it absorbs quickly, making it suitable for both morning and nighttime use.

while it’s great at calming the skin, it also provides essential hydration without feeling heavy or clogging pores. my skin feels moisturized and comfortable.

the cream helps to balance the skin’s pH, which is crucial for maintaining a healthy skin barrier. it’s a step towards healthier and more resilient skin.
reviews.zh:
呢款面霜喺舒緩皮膚方面非常強勁。佢可以有效減輕紅位、刺激同發炎，係我舒緩皮膚嘅首選產品。

面霜質地輕盈、唔油膩，塗喺皮膚上感覺舒服。佢吸收快，所以朝早同晚上都啱用。

佢喺舒緩皮膚方面表現出色，同時提供所需水分，唔會感覺厚重，亦唔會堵塞毛孔。我嘅皮膚感覺滋潤、舒服。

呢款面霜有助平衡皮膚嘅 pH 值，對維持健康嘅皮膚屏障好關鍵。佢係邁向更健康、更有韌性皮膚嘅一步。
